name: Gujarat Intrux Limited
summary: Gujarat Intrux Limited manufactures and supplies stainless, non-alloy, and alloy steel castings in India. The company exports its products in Germany, Israel, the United States, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Finland. It serves pumps and valves; earth moving; gas, oil, and instrumentation; and general engineering casting industries. Gujarat Intrux Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Rajkot, India.
